changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clients (name, email) SELECT 'Client ' || i, 'client' || i || '@example.com' FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS i;
INSERT INTO accounts (client_id, account_number, balance) SELECT id, 'ACC-' || id, 1000.00 FROM clients;

INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, amount, type, transaction_date) SELECT (i % 100) + 1, (random() * 1000)::NUMERIC(19,4), CASE WHEN i % 2 = 0 THEN 'TRANSFER_IN' ELSE 'TRANSFER_OUT' END, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' + random() * INTERVAL '300 days' FROM generate_series(1, 50000) AS i;
